_comment: Copy to your game's root as android_game.json. Every key is explained in docs/SETTINGS.md. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
title: YOUR GAME
disc_prompt:
Choose your Your Game (USA) disc.

Select the .cue file and all of its .bin files together
(tap and hold the first one, then tap the others),
or a single .chd file.

They are copied into the app once.
